newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian police arrest 36 in ecstasy drugs bust.
newsitem.headline: Italian police arrest 36 in ecstasy drugs bust.

text.p: Italian police said on Monday they had arrested 36 people and were seeking another two after a 14-month investigation into drugs-pushing in seaside discotheques.
Carabinieri paramilitary police said 9,000 tablets of the fashionable drug ecstasy had been seized in the operation, which began in August last year.
Hashish and cocaine had also been confiscated.
Police said those arrested were suspected of running a drugs ring which smuggled ecstasy from the Netherlands to the central Italian city of Bologna.
They believe the drugs were distributed for sale in at least a dozen discotheques in Rimini and other fashionable Adriatic coast resorts.
